test: cypress/integration/msgprint.js > Msgprint > clears an open message before showing a server message
observed: A newly added spec causes CI flakes: the second test in the file sometimes starts with a message dialog already on screen from the first test. The file logs in once in before() and visits /app/todo once, then every test uses the same page. Some runs also fail early with a TypeError when the test reads frappe from the window right after the visit.
error: AssertionError: Timed out retrying after 4000ms: expected '<div.modal-dialog.msgprint-dialog>' to contain text 'server message', but the text was 'client message'
environment: The tests call frappe.msgprint and frappe.request.cleanup on the window object of the shared page; cy.hide_dialog() is called at the end of the first test.
